Scene: a sunlit Victorian botanical glasshouse with a pale mint iron window grid, golden morning light and a glimpse of a lush garden. A round cream wall clock with dark hands high on the left; high right a framed botanical print with three leaves. A wood potting bench spans the middle of the scene. Arrange on or near it: a yellow watering can with an arched handle at left, a terracotta pot with a flowering pink plant near the middle, a blue ceramic vase with white polka dots at right, a hanging red lantern from the upper beam, a little wooden birdhouse near the right window, a stack of three gardening books, a pair of scissors and an apple on the bench. Foreground: woven wicker basket at lower left, a short wooden stool with a white teacup and saucer near the middle, patterned terracotta floor tiles and a cream gardening glove near lower right. Small butterflies outside window, leaf veins, clock hands, book spines, pottery motifs and lantern crossbars are carefully legible. Color palette honey oak, sage, cream, dusty coral, soft turquoise. Camera sees the entire tidy room with pleasing depth.
